title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after her father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.

title: Amma Vanthachu
desc: Nandakumar, a medical representative, meets Nandini, a salesgirl, and both fall in love. Trouble visits their relationship in the form of a young child, who claims to be Nandakumar's daughter.

title: Kaakha Kaakha
desc: ACP Anbuselvan succeeds in killing a dreaded gangster but Pandya, the gangster's brother, kills Maya, Anbuselvan's wife. Later, Anbuselvan goes all out to finish Pandya and his gang.

title: Sengathu Boomiyile
desc: Vallarasu and Chinnasamy are two friends who come from closely related families. However, a fateful incident drives a wedge between them, culminating in a violent fight.

title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.
